bottleneck.description: Global leader in high-power fiber lasers with vertical integration in pump diodes; structural top-5 oligopoly with TRUMPF, Coherent, nLIGHT, Lumentum.

dependency.key_customers: EV battery weld lines, cutting/welding integrators (Amada, Bystronic, Han's), aerospace, defense directed energy
dependency.key_suppliers: Internally vertically integrated in pump diodes; specialty optics from Lumentum/Coherent peers

editorial.notes: IPG has structural leadership in high-power industrial fiber lasers with vertical integration in pump diodes (a real moat that took peers ~15 years to approach). The top-5 cohort controls >60% of fiber laser share, and IPG remains the de-facto reference for >10kW industrial cutting/welding. However, Chinese Raycus (~30% China share) and MaxPhotonics have eroded the moat in commodity power bands, and Coherent/TRUMPF compete at the high end. MEDIUM reflects oligopoly position with credible substitutes at most power tiers.
